carrier_contract.name: Editorial wall poster
critical_signals: visible poster edge or mounting logic
carrier_contract.safe_margin: 5–9% of page width unless the poster crop is intentionally aggressive
carrier_contract.title_priority: dominant; supporting information stays subordinate and attaches to the title axis, frame, object tangent, perspective line, mask, or perimeter
carrier_contract.crop_behavior: allow decisive crop at one or more edges

composition.composition_sentence: TITLE_MASS + SINGLE_OBJECT + COUNTERBALANCE + SCALE_CONTRAST + RELEASE_ZONE + SHARED_ALIGNMENT
composition.subject_mass_rule: Treat the single subject as one complete, cropped, fragmented, or field-like mass according to the Composition Contract.

operators.definition: Place unequal title and subject masses in complementary regions joined by one shared structural cue.
Attach at least three major or support elements to one shared edge, axis, baseline, or curvature.
Make one element intentionally much larger or smaller than expected without creating a second focal event.

focal_event.definition: One element is intentionally much larger or smaller than expected, creating the memorable event.
focal_event.thumbnail_test: the scale relationship is visible at 25% size

composition.object_slot: one large side-biased mass; complete or edge-cropped according to scale role
composition.collision_rule: title and subject share one edge, tangent, or shaped counter-space; they do not float as unrelated halves
composition.crop_rule: crop one or two outer edges when the subject exceeds 36% of the canvas; protect 2–4 identity anchors
composition.release_zone: one large low-information field around the scale anomaly
composition.thumbnail_test: title reads first and the unequal counterweight relationship is visible before details

subject.origin_definition: An invented, apparently functional object imagined through optimistic streamline-era futurism: a rounded, exaggerated volume with coherent construction logic and a small set of purpose-bearing parts.
subject.mass_rule: Treat the single subject as one complete, cropped, fragmented, or field-like mass according to the Composition Contract.
subject.render_definition: Build the form or invented device from the active palette so its body, light, shadow, haze, and gradient read as one continuous color system.
subject.color_rule: Object color derives from ACTIVE_HUES and their tints; no unrelated local product color is introduced.
subject.scale_behavior: The subject and title share primary attention through counter-space, tangent, or one common axis.
subject.function: Two builders prototype together around a suspended shared worktable.
purpose_bearing_parts: suspended shared worktable inside the cabin
two warm docking bridges holding the cabin in the loop
continuous maintenance seam following the ribbon curvature

morphology.name: Toroidal ribbon commons
morphology.shape_ancestry: one inflated toroidal ribbon folds around a pearl-like inhabited cavity, combining a continuous loop, suspended inner volume, and open center
morphology.definition: A collaborative prototyping habitat that lets two builders work around a suspended shared workspace, derived from a continuous loop rather than a pod, vehicle, or room with softened corners.
morphology.silhouette: a broad soft loop sweeps upward and around one smaller hanging cabin, leaving a large intentional opening that makes the object recognizable at thumbnail size
morphology.exaggeration: make the enclosing loop dramatically wider than the cabin and stretch its upper arc into a buoyant directional gesture
morphology.aperture_rule: treat the loop's open center and one convex cabin window as integrated functional negative spaces; use no flat windshield or black display band
construction_cues: two warm docking bridges suspend the cabin from the enclosing loop
one continuous maintenance seam follows the loop curvature
one softly glowing underside cavity explains lift without exposed contemporary propulsion hardware
morphology.material_direction: powder-blue molded fiberglass, softly tinted bubble glass, warm brushed-metal bridge details, cream upholstery, and gentle illustrated surface grain
hard_failures: a current car, appliance, laptop, speaker, robot, or phone with rounded corners
faceted stealth surfaces, razor edges, angular cybertruck geometry, or aggressive contemporary supercar stance
black panoramic glass bands, full-width LED strips, touchscreen-first dashboards, RGB light, holographic UI, or cold gray-white minimalism
generic matte ceramic blob with no silhouette exaggeration, functional opening, or construction logic
photoreal automotive advertising, cinematic road scenes, chrome covering the whole object, or hard neon rim light

subject.screen_rendering_rule: Do not add a display, interface, glow, or control surface merely to make the subject look technological.

palette.derived_tints: derive pale, mid, and soft-deep tones only from the active hues
palette.gradient_direction: one oversized color field blooms inward from an off-canvas edge
palette.primary_form: one continuous toroidal ribbon folds around a suspended pearl-like cabin, leaving a large open center; retain two warm docking bridges, curved maintenance seam, convex cabin window, and underside lift cavity

detail_roles.echo: 1 much smaller corner brackets echo instance(s)

palette.alignment_system: first distribute visual weight across complementary regions, then align at least three of title, hero or atmospheric form, panel, label, bridge, and accents through a shared edge, axis, tangent, baseline, or curvature; the relationship may span the canvas and must not stack all high-information elements in one region

background.requirement: Render a finished, fully opaque full-bleed poster. The selected gradient is the bottommost background layer and covers 100% of the canvas behind the title, subject, negative space, and every cropped edge. No transparency or alpha anywhere.
background.coverage: 100% of the canvas behind every element and every cropped edge

negative_constraints: No designed letters, words, numbers, logos, watermarks, pseudo-text, or copy outside the locked inventory.
Keep the title first at thumbnail size and preserve the title glyph clear zone.
Resolve all visible objects as one perceptually unified subject mass; do not create equal-weight hero objects.
Do not depict a present-day product with rounded corners, faceted contemporary vehicle surfaces, or cold minimal-product language.
No black panoramic glass band, full-width LED strip, touchscreen-first controls, RGB light, or chrome-covered body.
